_readme: Approved statements from the live game (/api/statements), pulled 2026-11-12. Edit this file and run `python3 print/build.py` to rebuild the print files.

statements.text: Refuses to wear a coat, no matter how cold it is.
Insists on pressing the elevator button themselves.
Gets upset when someone else's tower is taller.
Everything is either “the best” or “a total disaster”.
Needs a nap after lunch, but will deny being tired.
Only eats food that is beige.
Talks about themselves in the third person.
Has to be the first one through the door.
Announces the same achievement several times a day.
Should not be left alone with a phone.
Gets louder when asked to be quieter.
Will not admit to knocking over the lamp.
Deeply interested in large trucks.
Would like a parade.
Has a hairstyle that takes longer than the rest of getting dressed.
Gives everyone they meet a nickname.
Has fallen asleep somewhere they were supposed to be paying attention.
Grabs things that belong to other people.
Repeats a sentence louder rather than explaining it differently.
Became an expert on the subject yesterday.
“This mine!”
“I did it. I did it all by myself.”
“I'm not tired!”
“You're not my friend anymore.”
“He started it.”
“Mine was bigger.”
“No! I do it!”
“Watch me. Watch me. Watch me.”
“That's not fair!”
“Everybody says I'm the best at this.”
Wears diapers.
Has tantrums.
Cannot pronounce your name properly.
Afraid of the vacuum cleaner.
Needs help with buttons.
Doesn't like sharing.
Throws food.
Requires a specific cup.
Gets carried when tired.
Needs constant supervision.
Can drink a glass of water with one hand all by themself.
